question.prompt: Makayla attended two meetings during her \(9\)-hour work day. The first meeting took \(45\) minutes and the second meeting took twice as long. What percent of her work day was spent attending meetings?

solutions.explanation:
Use minutes for both the meeting time and the work day. The second meeting lasted \(2\cdot45=90\) minutes, so the meetings together lasted \(45+90=135\) minutes. Her work day lasted \(9\cdot60=540\) minutes. Therefore the percentage spent in meetings was
\[
\frac{135}{540}\cdot100\%
=\frac14\cdot100\%
=\boxed{25\%},
\]
choice \(\text{C}\).
solutions.title: Compare meeting time with the whole day
